title: Deriving-relevance-frontier (predicating-regime fiber selection morphism; ω < κ < ω₁)
description: Regime: transfinite-predication-category (predicating morphism). Maps (user-prompt, knowledge-region) → relevance-frontier object. Per emsenn 2026-05-28 reframe (substrate-as-AI): this morphism IS the AI's recall act — the LLM here functions as a dictionary/pattern-matcher we consult to identify which known entities the user is asking about. Mechanism: (1) extract known entity slugs from the knowledge-region cells (subjects of settled predications). (2) render a permissive HTML prompt presenting the entity list and the user-prompt, asking the LLM to identify matches. (3) call inferring; treat the response as untrusted text. (4) extract matches by substring-checking known entity slugs against the LLM's text response (we don't trust the LLM's structure; we extract what's in our known set). (5) build the relevance-frontier with matched entities + their neighborhood predications + missingKnowledge signal. Variance: restriction. The fiber slice IS predicating; the LLM call inside is delegated articulating but does not change this morphism's regime.
